summary: Backend report/auth regression passed; browser retest found the Reports selector label updates but export and print requests remain hardcoded to attendance.

integration_issues.issue: Selecting grades or journals updates the preview label but clicking export requests /api/reports/export?kind=attendance.
Selecting journals and opening print produces attendance HTML (title Rekap Absensi Siswa), not the selected report kind.

action_items: Pass the selected kind through App's Reports onExport and onPrint callbacks instead of binding attendance unconditionally.
critical_code_review_comments: App render still uses onExport={() => downloadReport("attendance")} and onPrint={() => printReport("attendance")}; Reports state cannot reach the API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login and all 9 backend auth/report tests passed. Browser verified report label changes; grades/journals export and print still request attendance due to parent callback binding.
rca of the issue: Reports now owns kind state and passes it to callbacks, but App still supplies callbacks that ignore the argument and always call downloadReport/printReport with attendance. Change callbacks to accept kind and forward it. Browser print title reproduced as Rekap Absensi Siswa after selecting journals.
